axes.hierarchy: Document -> page -> question -> block -> run/figure/frame -> entity/mark. Knowledge hierarchy separately groups domain -> layer -> stage -> record.
axes.topology: Typed geometric incidence/ray/owner/equal-mark relations, plus a separate pipeline dependency graph; neither is reducible to folder placement.
axes.structure: Semantic content, mathematical construction, presentation, native question container and page template have separate ownership and revisions.
axes.type: Claims, mark provenance, coordinates, units, object kinds, evidence states and feedback attribution are discriminated; missing evidence remains unknown.

findings.claim: Evidence interpretation is the main repeated source of semantic defects; neat output and code execution do not establish original truth.
findings.action: Use source-mark inventories and typed claims before style cleanup.

findings.claim: Historical SVG paths provide appearance control and finite constructions but do not consistently carry executable semantic topology.
findings.action: Reuse renderers and migrate only affected entities to stable typed constructors; avoid a wholesale rewrite.

findings.claim: Equation whitespace has multiple layers; historical bounded widening and blanket safety padding must not be recalled as a completed narrowing algorithm.
findings.action: Use exact native metrics, environment-bound cache keys and ink-to-following-glyph checks.

findings.claim: Question ownership and repeated page composition are different structures.
findings.action: Keep whole-question native containers separate from local block layout and content-dependent page slots.

findings.claim: Research publication, installed code, response transport, native application, output verification and user completion differ.
findings.action: Route by evidence class and exact capability scope rather than a single ready boolean.

findings.claim: Optimization needs frozen comparable attempts and typed dependency attribution; producer confidence and missing costs cannot fill evidence gaps.
findings.action: Capture FeedbackEvent once and hand off to existing rubric/evaluator ownership; measure quality and total cost/time independently.

backwardPropagation.meaning: Evidence-grounded error attribution and selective recomputation, not gradient training.
backward: exact output defect -> native control/content node
node -> producing attempt and input revisions
decision -> source region and actual authority
forward: retain failed/corrected pair and independent quality/cost/time evidence
backwardPropagation.ambiguity: Cause status stays suspected or unknown until supporting evidence exists.

implemented: stage impact and source trace queries
proposed: automatic producer dependency manifests beyond manually authored Daechi graph
environment fingerprint enforcement at every native metric reuse
mark-provenance classifier with independently labelled source regions
measurementsRequired: provider-reported paid cost plus unknown liabilities
